sql:
SELECT SUM(fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10.queue_lots) AS total_queue_lots
FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10
WHERE fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10.fab_id = 'fab10'
AND fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10.interval_end = (
  SELECT MAX(fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10.interval_end)
  FROM fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10
  WHERE fab10.live_process_snapshots_fab10.fab_id = 'fab10'
)

limitations: Sums across disjoint areas at the latest simulation snapshot; does not group or output area/toolgroup dimensions.
Excludes any non-latest snapshots; always uses the global maximum interval_end for the given fab_id.
